## Summer Research Intern, Quantum Convolutional Codes

**University of Massachusetts Amherst**, Center for Quantum Networks

Advisors: Dr. Filip Rozpedek and Dr. Stefan Krastanov.

- Quantum convolutional codes within the stabilizer formalism
- Entanglement purification and distillation protocols using convolutional quantum codes
- Simulation of quantum repeater protocols under realistic noisy hardware
- Open-source tools for quantum error correction in Julia

## Research Intern, JuliaSmoothOptimizers

**Polytechnique Montréal**

Advisor: Prof. Dominique Orban (Department of Applied Mathematics).

Translated classical optimization problems into JuMP and ADNLPModels for
[OptimizationProblems.jl](https://github.com/JuliaSmoothOptimizers/OptimizationProblems.jl),
documented their mathematical formulations and the contributing guidelines, and added
dimension-modification warnings, type corrections and tests. Contributed pull requests
across the JSO ecosystem.

## Summer Research Intern, Quantum Fisher Information

**Mahindra University** · Hyderabad

Advisor: Dr. Naga Deepthi (Department of Physics).

Quantum Fisher information bounds on CP-phase sensitivity in long-baseline neutrino
experiments (T2K, NOvA), and groundwork on neutrino decoherence under scalar
non-standard interactions.

## LFX Mentee, Linux Kernel

**The Linux Foundation**

Linux Kernel Bug Fixing Mentorship with Shuah Khan. Thirty patches applied upstream so
far. Fifteen came during the mentorship, in the IIO subsystem and in networking (sfc):
the most recent six fix bugs in the Semtech SX9xxx proximity drivers, the MCP3564 ADC
and the IIO core's number parser ([blog post](posts/2026-10-26-sx93xx-fixes/index.qmd)),
and the first nine, including fixes for truncated 64-bit divisions in scmi_sensors and
for wrong magnetometer scales and swapped startup times in inv_mpu6050, are covered in
[an earlier post](posts/2026-10-22-lfx-kernel-mentorship/index.qmd). Fifteen more have
been applied since, across IIO, networking (vmxnet3), ALSA and ASoC sound, and
platform/x86, several of them tested on my own laptop
([running log](posts/2026-11-13-kernel-patches/index.qmd)).
